limits: The Codex side is generated, not verified. The keys name, description, developer_instructions, sandbox_mode and model come from this ticket's own text and have never been read by a Codex release, because no Codex session has run on this repository. doctor checks that a copy matches its source, not that Codex accepts it, and the first Codex session settles it.

[agents] max_depth = 1 lives in .codex/config.toml, which this repository deliberately does not track, so nothing here can check that a Codex subagent may not spawn another. The skill tells a session to set it on its own machine.

The reviewer holds Bash, because it cannot read a diff without it, and Claude Code has no read-only Bash. On that side the reviewer is held to reading by its instructions and by holding no Edit and no Write, and nothing refuses a write it makes through a shell. Do not read this delivery as proof that a reviewer subagent cannot change the tree it reviews; that is SEEN-106.

reviewer_session is a declaration, not a proof. A Claude Code subagent inherits its parent's session id, so the gate refuses the case it can see, a session that wrote a record on this ticket, and cannot detect a value typed to pass. The control that stands where that matters is the cross-assistant review, which this ticket does not require of itself.

Criterion 5 is amended, not met as written. The measurement, the attribution and the report row are delivered and tested; no figure below the SEEN-099 baseline exists yet, and [context] agents_available_from keeps this ticket out of the row that will carry it. SEEN-106 produces the figure.
The fixes made after the third review were read by no reviewer. The review record attests the fixed tree, and its checks say so.

Nothing is deployed. This branch touches the harness, its documents and its generated copies only: no database table, no credential, no marketplace call, no TypeScript, and coverage on @seen/core unchanged at every attempt.
